description: Reads an ISO 20022 XML message (pacs, pain, camt, seev…) and explains it block by block from a hand-written glossary: parties, amounts, dates, identifiers and charges, with the meaning of each element and code. Elements the glossary has no entry for are listed, never guessed. Does not validate: use validate_message for that. Nothing is stored. Same code as https://iomarkets.tech/explain.
name: explain_iso20022_message
title: Explain an ISO 20022 message in plain words
